main_text.p: crum, quod ex se ὅσιον[?] non est, est illi tamen ὅσιον, ita ut ab eo abstinere teneatur, ficut a re vere sacra. Et si error mentis sufficit ad inducendum obligationem; multo magis mala voluntas fallendi proximum obligationem inducet. Quia iustum est, ut vir impius & dolosus incidat in foveam quam fodit proximo suo, & ut illi laqueo quem tetendit ' alteri implicitus sit pes suus.
main_text.head: SECT. X.
main_text.p: Quatuor eorum quae nunc expofui criteriorum is usus est, siquando quaestio vel scrupulus oriatur in conscientia, de aliqua loquendi formula quae videtur habere speciem juramenti, habeatne vere & formaliter rationem, & consequenter vim Obligatoriam Juramenti, vel non? Protenus[?] ut ad haec criteria recurratur, atque examen illius formulae ad has ve-ut[?] notas Διαγνωστικὰς[?], idque eo quo pro-posui[?] ordine, incipiendo a prima atque percurrendo singulas, si opus fuerit: Sed est, nisi ante ex jam peracto examinatis[?] constiterit quod sit juramentum: Potest enim constare affirmatio, sc: quod

page.notes: Left edge: letters clipped by the scan edge; not transcribed as text. "ὅσιον" in line 1 is printed as a superscript Greek word; the reading is uncertain. "ve-ut" at the line end and "pro-posui" are doubtful; the hyphen at "examine/atis" is not clearly printed. The mark after "tetendit" is a small typographic mark, kept as printed. The Greek word at "Διαγνωστικὰς" is doubtful. The first letter of "Protenus" is cut off at the margin. Long s is printed as "f" throughout and has been normalised to s.
